## Evidence

If you used F11, paste the automatic context and attach the reviewed `report.json`
from the report folder if helpful. The shortcut does not submit issues or upload
files automatically. See `docs/BUG_REPORTING.md` for details.

Add relevant log excerpts, screenshots or a short video if available. For collision
problems, include the F8 debug overlay when possible.

Do not attach ROMs, saves, extracted game assets or memory dumps. Remove personal
paths from logs before sharing.
